nom: DRMTLGY Brightening Eye Masks with Peptides and Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I enjoyed the product while it lasted, but unfortunately despite the jar being sealed shut the mask conpletely dried out.

avis.titre: I'm in the minority here but I don't love these
avis.texte: I have used tons of under eye patches from different brands and these fall low on the list of those I enjoy. They tend to slip around and I don't necessarily feel like they leave me with any hydration or depuffing after I've applied them. Just not a fan.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: This product doesn't do what it describes it will do. I was suggested this product by a worker to help with reducing puffiness. However, it doesn't help at all.

I have been using these masks since before Ulta carried them and I will never be without them! Depuff, hydrate, help with my dark circles and fine lines. When it's hot, they are fantastic from the fridge. I even bought a smaller container they fit into to take them when I travel. They ARE swimming in serum which is not a bad thing. I tend to skim a little off each mask on the side of/back into the container prior to applying and then they don't slide. I then pat any excess on my fingers on my forehead and/or upper lip. I keep on a minimum of 15 minutes, usually closer to 30. When I've finished the container, I will take all that leftover serum and apply it all over my face, neck and decollate if there is enough. I seriously can't live without these!

These are the absolute BEST eye masks! They really help hydrate my eye area and reduce the dark circles. Keep them in the fridge for a really nice cooling effect. So glad that Ulta is now carrying Drmtlgy products.

I was so excited to try these after I finished off my PTR eye patches. What a disappointment they've been. There is way too much liquid in them. They are hard to handle, and slimy. After removing them and patting in the (copious ampunts of) excess liquid my under eyes are left sticky. Gross. I guess I'll try to drain out some of the liquid.

I wanted to love these eye masks as everyone was raving about them. Thry ate veey wet, difficult to get out and thry do not stick in place. They constantly slide down. Forth price i expected better product and results that lasted. I would not buy again and would tell people to keep shopping for something else.

avis.titre: really works too de- puff my eyes in the morning
avis.texte: I store this in the refrigerator so that it is cool. I do keep them on 20 to 30 minutes in the morning after I wake up. But they work great to de-puff and brighten my eyes.

Bought these on a whim. As a night shift worker, I've slowly begun to have puffiness under my eyes and bags. These did the trick and they feel soo good on when applied on the skin. Very cooling! Once empty, buying more!

I normally don't see the point in eye masks since they never work, but I was intrigued by these after reading the reviews. These really work. I love them! I see a noticable difference every time I use them, and my fine lines are disappearing after only two weeks of daily use. Don't hesitate!

I never really understood the purpose of undereye patches. I thought it never really made a difference & it was a waste of money. THIS PRODUCT HERE?? It really really works. I was so surprised. It is verh good, highly recommend. 1000/10
These are very easy to put on and they stay on very well while I do some cleaning. My under eye lines look so smooth after and they feel hydrated!
This is my second time buying. Helps puffiness somewhat but love the cooling effect

I can't even review the efficacy because i immediately hated these. I put them on and they slide everywhere. I couldn't even do a face mask with it and relax. I had to lay flat on my back to even use them. The are no good if i can't put them on and get ready or do anything other than lay down and stay completely still.
Bought these to de-puff under my eyes. Does nothing, even when placed in the refrigerator.

avis.titre: Helped Brighten and Depuff my Eyes!
avis.texte: The serum amount in the jar is the most ive ever had and its amazing. This jar wont dry out like all the others ive had in the past and its well worth the money. I stick it in the fridge and they feel cooling and so nice for my eyes after a long day
I put these in the fridge and used trembles when I woke up looking tired. It refreshed and hydrated my under eyes.
This is a great product. I've just recently started putting two at a time on period one on my eyelid and one under my eye. What a huge difference.

I have tried many different brightening eye masks but these are the only ones I have on subscription re-order and can't live without. Brighten, moisturize, fill the fine lines and get rid of the bags. Don't hesitate, these are must haves!
Thanks again for a wonderful product! Cool and refreshing for tired puffy eyes. Really makes a difference
When I wake up in the morning, my under eyes are always puffy but when i use the eye masks , I can see it calming down and disappears .

These are so refreshing and easy to use. Very thin, sometimes I forget that I have them on. My skin is so soft after use. I'm summer months I keep them in the fridge for an extra cool experience.
Whenever I need to look more awake, I slap on my Brightening Eye Masks and I feel like a million bucks!
I cannot live without these! They are the absolute best! Get them on subscription right away! My eyes have never looked so hydrated and great for those fine lines! Game changer!
This eyes mask instantly refreshes my understanding of eye area!I love how bright and hydrated my skin.
I keep them in the refrigerator to get a nice cooling feel! I am amazed how well they work!
These under eye pads are amazing! I keep them in the refrigerator and use them cold in the mornings. I got my Mom a box of them for Christmas to try!
Love the brightening eye masks! Use them every morning when I wake up and my under eye dark circles and puffiness are almost gone. Look refreshed and feel refreshed

I am using my little eye-brightening masks every morning for 15 minutes or so. When I take them off I smooth the remaining serum into my skin around my eyes. They really work! My bags are gone and I feel like I look much more awake (I'm not a morning person, so they help a lot with helping me look less droopy!). I hope over time they will continue to firm and brighten that area under my eyes. I'm 67 and I don't have any crows feet, and these masks help with that too! I really love them!

Love these eye masks! I use them in the morning and before an evening event to give my eyes an instantly refreshed look. They're generously bathed with serum in the jar, so be sure to let the excess drip off before applying each patch. Highly recommend!
These are amazing. I put them on my eyes and feel like I am getting a mini Spa treatment!
These are amazing. I keep them in the refrigerator. They are so refreshing to use after a.long day. Love the moisturizer feeling that they give as well.
Love these! I feel like they really work. I think my dark under eyes have lightened a lot after using
I love them. I have bags under my eyes and the mask feel great and soothing.
I have using the eye masks and been loving them. They are refreshing and help with puffiness. Love them.
My eyes looked brighter after just one use, I put them in the fridge for an additional coolness

I discovered DRMTLY about 1.5 years ago, and love their products since. They are included in my daily ritual. I normally don't recommend products to friends and family, but DRMTLGY is so different that I could not recommend them. I recommended them to two Ladies I used to work this and they have recently become customers as well. The products speak for themself. Just love them.

I've struggled with dark circles under my eyes since I was young. I always thought it was a genetic thing, and no matter what I was doomed to look like I've never slept, or having to use under eye concealer for the rest of my life. I put these on, waited the 15 minutes.. and nearly fell over ... I looked normal and I didn't even have to fiddle around trying to make sure the concealer was even, and matched my skin tone. for the first time ever my eyes don't look like I have two black eyes. every product I've purchased from DRMTLGY has been great, but this one is incredible enough for me to write a review and say "don't be too skeptical, these eye masks work!"
Love these masks. I like to keep them in the refrigerator. They are very refreshing on your eyes!
I have only been using for about a week but I really like them! It feels nice and cool and I like using something in addition to eye cream. Looking forward to seeing how they continue to work
I cannot say enough good about the quality of these mask. They are extremely hydrating and brightening. I love the way my under eyes feel refreshed.
So refreshing. I keep mine in the freezer, and oh my what a difference! Love them
Perfect way to start or end the day. These eye masks are a game changer . My eyes feel highly moisturized and and also helps with puffiness in the am. A must have!

I really like the eye masks. I can place them on after my shower as I get ready for the day. By the time I prep my hair for blow drying or get ready to apply makeup my treatment is done. My under eyes feel refreshed ,smooth, hydrated and ready to apply makeup or not.
I love the soft looking texture under my eyes and renewed brightness of my skin. I would love to take a bath in this stuff!!!
I put these in the fridge for a refreshing under eye experience ! Seems to help when my eyes have some puffiness to them. 5 stars for me !

I had this eye mask on my wish list for a while but finally purchased it a couple of months ago and I'm so glad I did!! It is extremely hydrating and makes me look well-rested and refreshed after using it. I keep it in the fridge and it feels amazing when it's cold! The only negative is (and it's probably a personal issue) that it slides down my face so I have to readjust it frequently during a 10-15 minute period. I'll deal with that in exchange for the happy under eyes, though!

I'd never thought to use a product like this until it was mentioned when I was in a beauty store recently. I hadn't planned to buy it either - until I was on the Drmtlgy website buying an under eye corrector and it was a suggested product. I have enjoyed using it so far - I've only used it twice (once a week for two weeks) so I can't really comment on its long term uses - but I like having them on, and I also really like the way my skin feels/looks afterwards.
Soothing and refreshing. I really like this product. Will buy again.
These eye patches are my favorite. I keep them in the fridge and put them on every morning. Helps reduce dark circles and hydrates my eyes.
These are my absolute favorite! I keep them stored in my refrigerator and look forward to putting them on every morning. You can't go wrong with this purchase!
I've used so many under eye treatments and this one is by far the best. Highly recommend!
These work really well I see a difference in my under eyes after just one use

Hesitated to try these due to reading some negative reviews. Received them as a free sample and WOW! These are amazing. First time use, I had remarkable results. Under eye fine lines seemed to disappear, area felt hydrated and look brightened. Although left the skin a bit tacky, I used a tiny bit of the advanced eye cream. My corrector applied easily. Definitely will continue to use these once or twice a week. Really impressed.
Do NOT hesitate to buy these. So refreshing for the delicate skin under the eyes, leaving it supple and quenched.
One box can use for one month , I will put it in cold area before using
I try eye masks out all the time for my puffy under eyes, these are some of the only ones that I notice help calm things down.

I love this product. I keep them in the refrigerator for the added cooling benefits. They're great for hydrating and depuffing the skin under my eyes. They're especially great during allergy season and waking up tired eyes from lack of sleep. Two thumbs up.
Sometimes I get up in the morning with circles around my eye even though I slept good. This eye patch does the trick and makes it go away. I have seen the magic;)

I have been using these for two months and the results are amazing. My laugh lines are mostly gone. The puffiness under my eyes is significantly reduced. The dark circles are significantly reduced. Now if only we could make a full face mask out of the same thing it would be awesome. Lol

avis.titre: Gentle, Cooling, and It Actually Works
avis.texte: These have become part of my morning routine. They feel cool and soothing, and I can see a difference in how bright my under-eyes look. A simple little self-care step that actually works.
I love using these after the gym. I don't sleep very well and you wouldn't know it, I truly believe it's because of using these regularly.
These freshen up my tired eyes 100% of the time. In the morning before work or before date night they're the perfect beauty trick

I have never used eye patches before and I have decided to give them a try and I am genuinely amazed and pleasantly surprised. I allow the patches to sit for approximately 15 minutes and I can see a visible difference in my under eyes. Every morning is a good morning when I use these bad boys! This was the missing piece to my skincare routine I never knew I needed.
My eyes feel refreshed and love using them in the mornings feel so good. Keep them in th refrigerator so refreshing

I started these and I like the way left my skin under my eyes now I put them in the refrigerator and it really feels good with them. Cool I've noticed after using them for about two weeks that my eyes are not puffy anymore. I like these better than the other products I've used under my eyes. I've gotten better results with these.
Amazing results to combat puffiness and uneven skin tone under the eyes.
I have to have these as part of my daily routine. They hydrate my under eyes and make sure my bags are glowing! I keep these in my fridge so they are cool when I put them on.
I've only tried these 1 time but, they seem to work. They definitely are soothing. Let's see how they de-puff with continued use.

avis.titre: So refreshing and brightening for tired eyes
avis.texte: These eye masks feel so soothing from the moment I apply them. The gel texture stays in place and gives a cooling, de-puffing effect that wakes up my under-eye area. After using them, my skin looks smoother, more hydrated, and definitely brighter. Makeup applies better too because the fine lines look softened. Perfect for mornings after little sleep or whenever I want a quick refresh and glow around the eyes.
I wear them every morning and night. My eyes feel rejuvenated and less puffy. Thanks DRMTLGY!

avis.titre: I am on my second contain
avis.texte: I am on my second container of these. I can see a difference with less dryness under my eyes and they leave a refreshed awake look. Very happy with my purchase!

This is the first DRMTLGY product I used! I was amazed how they left my under eyes after using them! I love them! I keep them in the fridge so they are extra cool and they de-puff beautifully! I highly recommend these!
This is amazing because they really helped me lighten the dark circles under my eyes.

I have been using the Brightening Eye Masks for 2 years. I always refrigerate them before use. They take away the puffiness of my under eye area and brighten my dark circles. They work very well. I had tried several other similar products before using them. Nothing works as well as these.
Your Underage masks seem to be working well. I've only been using them for about 5 days now so not too long. So we will have to see.....
I like the feeling of the cold eye masks in the morning. I don't know yet whether they are helpful for puffiness or lines, but they are nice. I think I will send some to my sister for a present.

I use these at least one a week. They are so moisturizing and I see instant results with fine lines.

End my day with these masks. A time to relax and get the cool freshening feeling of these masks. I have been seeing less puffiness and dark circles. Will continue to use them everyday.
I have been using these brightening eye masks for a couple years now. I will always use these.

Put these in the fridge ! It really helps with puffiness and hydration. Recommend using daily to see results .
These are so soothing! I just started using these and can see a difference already!
